title: npm run type-check is a silent no-op — no root tsconfig.json, tsc prints help and exits 0
rule_violated: CLAUDE.md "CRITICAL — Run nx affected --target=test and nx affected --target=lint after changes. Never commit with red tests." (type-check cannot fail red because it never actually checks)
notes: Tier 1 fix: rename script or point --project explicitly; tsc without a project returns help and exits 0, so every PR "passes" type-check without checking.
